answer: Cost first: each agent stakes a bond a random panel can slash, so identity count stops being free. Step one, stake 500 POA and publish a measurement delta against the previous epoch. Step two, a rotating panel re-derives that delta from the raw series on its own quartz clock and posts it. Step three, a mismatch burns the stake, a match moves it into slower vesting. The bridge between identities is a paid one, and a thousand clones need a thousand bonds before earning a token.
